key_patterns.issue: Navigation lacks clear demo or pricing link
key_patterns.evidence: User noted no obvious link to a demo request or pricing summary from the navigation bar, causing uncertainty.

key_patterns.issue: Hero section uses jargon and unclear CTA
key_patterns.evidence: User hesitated, asking how to request a demo or see pricing, indicating the “Get started” label was unclear.

strongest_conversion_signals: User continued after seeing specifics on trial access, pricing, and integration effort in the hero section.

recommended_actions.action: Add a prominent, clearly labeled “Request Demo” or “Pricing” link in the main navigation and replace ambiguous “Get started” with explicit CTA text.
recommended_actions.reason: Simulation showed hesitation due to missing demo/pricing links and jargon, suggesting clearer CTAs could reduce friction.
